title: Plinth AI: Product Photos

candidates.name: Plinth AI: Product Photos
candidates.why: The owner locked AI into the title on 2026-10-17; Plinth remains the short carrier and Product Photos keeps the seller's job explicit.

candidates.name: Plinth: Product Photos
candidates.why: One short carrier that no Play title among 30 visible cards uses, plus the two words a seller types; the plinth image (the item is the exhibit) is honest to the promise that the item stays untouched.

candidates.name: Vitrine: Product Photos
candidates.why: The shop-window image is apt, but Vitrine Shop and Vitrine Furniture are on the shelf and the word reads as a furniture store.

candidates.name: Stagely: Product Photos
candidates.why: Stagely is an exact existing title and Stager AI Home Virtual Staging owns the stem, so it loses on uniqueness and suggests home staging.

candidates.name: Shelfie: Product Photos
candidates.why: Five apps are titled Shelfie, so the carrier cannot be owned.

candidates.name: Lotshot: Product Photos
candidates.why: No exact title exists but it reads as auction-lot photography, narrower than the whole selling job.

candidates.name: Product Photo Editor
candidates.why: Negative control: the bare category phrase the incumbents own, unsearchable and unbrandable, and Editor is a generic category noun.

rejected.name: Vitrine: Product Photos
rejected.reason: Collides with Vitrine Shop and Vitrine Furniture on Google Play and reads as a furniture store.

rejected.name: Shelfie: Product Photos
rejected.reason: Five existing Play apps carry the exact title Shelfie.

rejected.name: Stagely: Product Photos
rejected.reason: An exact title exists and the stem belongs to a home staging app.

audience: Marketplace sellers who photograph their own goods on a phone and publish to Wildberries, Ozon, Avito, Vinted, eBay, Etsy, Depop, Amazon or Shopify, in English, Russian, German, French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
rationale: Owner locked “Plinth AI: Product Photos” on 2026-10-17; Plinth remains the gallery-block metaphor and Product Photos keeps the seller's job explicit.
collisionCheck: Play search on 2026-10-12 for plinth product photos found no title containing Plinth among 30 visible cards; the candidates Vitrine, Stagely and Shelfie collided and were rejected. A clean Play result is not trademark clearance and no trademark register was queried.
localisationCheck: The owner locked the AI-bearing title and localized titles on 2026-10-17; all six titles fit the 30-character Play cap. Non-English wording has not been independently reviewed by native speakers.
